summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery cycle_telemetry in cycle chat activity

delivery.outcome: Rename the generic telemetry-dict parameter 'cycle_telemetry' to stage-accurate names in each of the eight helper functions of src/koru/autonomy/cycle/cycle_chat_activity.py that mutate it: reflection_needs_input_telemetry (_upsert_reflection_needs_input_ticket), llx_reflection_telemetry (_record_llx_chat_reflection), needs_input_heuristic_telemetry (_apply_needs_input_heuristic), recent_drive_ack_skip_telemetry (_check_recent_drive_ack_skip), chat_intake_skip_telemetry (_check_chat_intake_skip), recent_self_drive_skip_telemetry (_check_recent_self_drive_skip), chat_activity_skip_telemetry (_apply_chat_activity_skip_decision), chat_activity_eval_telemetry (_evaluate_chat_activity_skip). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the group drops from 8 scopes to 0. The entry point _skip_due_to_recent_chat_activity (externally keyword-called with cycle_telemetry= from cycle_skip_conditions.py) and the two pure pass-through helpers (_apply_llx_chat_reflection, _gather_chat_activity_context) keep 'cycle_telemetry' because there it genuinely names the cycle-wide dict and produces no mutation records. Pure rename of parameters and their keyword call sites inside the module; no behavior change.
nonGoals: No behavior, telemetry-key, decision or interface change
No restructuring into a telemetry recorder class or central writer (each stage writes disjoint keys for its own decision; the shared generic name was the defect, not a missing abstraction)

No rename of the externally keyword-called parameter of _skip_due_to_recent_chat_activity, of cycle_telemetry parameters in other modules (cycle_chat_activity_analyzer.py, cycle_chat_activity_tickets.py, cycle_skip_conditions.py), and no touch of the separate pre-existing smells in cycle_chat_activity_config.py and cycle_chat_activity_tickets.py

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate parameter renames only, inside one module. Every mutating helper names the telemetry view of the decision stage it records; the umbrella name cycle_telemetry remains only at the gate entry and in the pure pass-throughs (_apply_llx_chat_reflection, _gather_chat_activity_context), which produce no mutation records. Verified with the code2llm shotgun-surgery detector: baseline groups cycle_telemetry mutations in 8 scopes in the file (>= 5 threshold fires), after the rename the largest group in the file is 2 scopes and no (file, variable) group reaches the threshold; the file's mutation count is unchanged (71), proving a pure rename.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the parameters are named cycle_telemetry again and the smell report returns.

commands: python3 -c "<standalone DFGExtractor + SmellDetector._detect_shotgun_surgery on cycle_chat_activity.py, original vs renamed>"
validation.evidence: Two-level verification on a plain /tmp copy of the tree at the accepted base SHA. (1) Deterministic ground truth: the installed code2llm DFGExtractor plus the real SmellDetector grouping run standalone on the single file reports the cycle_telemetry mutation group spanning exactly the 8 ticket-named scopes for the original content and no group >= 5 (largest 2) for the renamed content, with the mutation count unchanged (71) and no new shotgun entry. (2) End-to-end CLI cross-check with the ticket-generating invocation: original content emits the planfile ticket with dedupe key code2llm:smell:shotgun_surgery:src/koru/autonomy/cycle/cycle_chat_activity.py:500; renamed content emits no ticket for that file. The separate pre-existing findings (Shotgun Surgery: raw in cycle_chat_activity_config.py, God Function in cycle_chat_activity_tickets.py) are untouched by design.

commands: python -m pytest tests/test_autonomy_policy_engine.py tests/test_autonomous_redrive_cooldown.py tests/test_autonomous_cycle_chat_activity_text.py tests/test_autonomous_cycle_chat_activity_tickets.py tests/test_autonomy_policy_decision.py tests/test_decision_arbiter.py tests/test_decision_trace.py tests/test_cycle_orchestrator.py -q
validation.evidence: The focused suites pass unchanged in the ticket worktree (134 passed) and ruff reports zero errors on the touched file. The full tests/test_autonomous.py run reports 3 failures (171 passed) that are pre-existing on the untouched base, verified by an A/B run of the exact three tests on a plain /tmp copy of the base tree with and without the renamed file: test_skip_due_to_recent_chat_activity_uses_heuristic_without_llx and test_skip_chat_activity_blocks_self_drive_even_without_ticket_ack fail on both variants (environmental baseline reds on this machine), and test_skip_due_to_recent_chat_activity_heuristic_can_be_disabled is network-flaky on both variants (3x renamed: fail/fail/pass; 3x original: pass/fail/fail) because it does not mock koru.autonomy.planning_llm.reflect_on_chat, so a live OpenRouter verdict decides whether a ticket is created. None of the three outcomes correlates with the rename; the renamed scopes are behaviorally covered by the focused suites asserting the same telemetry keys.
Managed governance gate passes with 0 errors from the ticket worktree.
